title: ChatHealthy Build Package Manifest
description: Per-target build-package manifest emitted by local_build / remote_build alongside the materialized deploy bytes under <build_root>/v{N}/<target_id>/. The manifest carries the target's slice of deployment_architecture.json (target_id, target_kind, environments, files, optional secrets), plus the build_number that mints v{N} and the build_sha that pins the source commit. Embedded file bytes are intentionally OMITTED from files[] — the materialized bytes live as actual files in the same package dir; carrying them in the manifest would double them. Secret VALUES never appear in this manifest (or anywhere in the package); the secrets map (when present) declares only the per-target {name -> store_id} bindings. local_deploy / remote_deploy read this file to drive shipping; SecretsResolver resolves values at deploy time from the bound store.

build_number.description: System-wide build counter mint at build time, sourced from admin.Versions.latest.builds[env=dev].build on the front-end cluster (see DeploymentArchitectureDesignAndMigrationPlanPhase_v14.docx section 2.1 build_chathealthy.py). v{build_number} names the package directory.

build_sha.description: Short git SHA of HEAD when the build ran. Pins the source bytes from which this package was materialized.

target_id.description: Same identifier as in deployment_architecture.json's DeploymentTargetRecord.

files.description: Lean list of files that compose this target's package. Mirrors deployment_architecture.json's files[] entries but with embedded_content + layout STRIPPED — the materialized bytes live as actual files under the package dir at source_location.

secrets.description: Per-target secret / environment key declarations carried forward from deployment_architecture.json. Map of key NAME -> store id. Values themselves NEVER appear in any package file.
